page_title: NEW 1-2 SUN | Newcastle v Sunderland 22/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' Anthony Taylor is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+9' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
90+9' Reinildo Mandava (Sunderland) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
90+6' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) sprays a pass out to Yoane Wissa, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
90+6' The attendance is 52253.
90+5' The resulting corner, taken by Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd), comes to nothing.

90+5' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) fails to produce a decent enough free kick for a player of his ability and the only target that he finds is the wall of defenders in front of him. Newcastle will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90+4' Lutsharel Geertruida (Sunderland) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
90+4' This is a yellow card! Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90+3' Today's match ends for Chemsdine Talbi who will be replaced by Reinildo Mandava (Sunderland).
90+3' Here is a change. Brian Brobbey is going off and Regis Le Bris gives the last tactical orders to Eliezer Mayenda (Sunderland).
90+1' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) is given a yellow card.
90+1' Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' 1 - 2 Goal! 1:2. Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.

90' Aaron Ramsdale pulls off a great save to deny Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
90' The statistic for corner kicks – 8:5. 8:15 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
89' The referee allows time for a substitution. Anthony Gordon will be replaced by Yoane Wissa (Newcastle Utd).
89' The referee awards a corner and Trai Hume (Sunderland) goes over to take it.

88' Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Sunderland have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
86' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
85' Close! Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.
85' A substitution has been made. Habib Diarra goes off and Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) comes on.
84' Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and tries to catch the keeper out, but the shot lacks accuracy and curls well wide of the right post.

84' Habib Diarra (Sunderland) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
82' Omar Alderete (Sunderland) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
82' Trai Hume (Sunderland) wastes no time in going for goal after collecting a rebound, but his long-range effort is comfortably blocked by a defender.
80' What a long-range shot by Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd). Unfortunately for him, his shot goes just a few inches over the bar.
79' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
76' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Harvey Barnes walks off the pitch to be replaced by William Osula (Newcastle Utd).
75' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Anthony Taylor due to a foul, much to the disappointment of the Malick Thiaw (Newcastle Utd) and his team.
75' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) prepares to take a corner kick.

74' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd). The ball goes out for a corner. Newcastle can continue in their attacking effort.
73' Trai Hume (Sunderland) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
72' Lutsharel Geertruida (Sunderland) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Sunderland have been awarded a corner kick.
72' A pass lands at the feet of Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
71' The corner from Lewis Hall evades the keeper, but Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) can't keep his close-range header down and fires it just over the bar.
71' There's an opportunity for Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

70' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick.
69' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

69' It's unbelievable, Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) blows a huge opportunity! He is totally unmarked and fires a first-time shot towards the roof of the net, but Aaron Ramsdale reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
68' Total attempts – 10:10. The number of shots on goal at present is 3:4.
67' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
67' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
66' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) sends a rebound goalwards towards the top left corner, but the goalkeeper stretches to stop it. Newcastle have a corner.
65' Eddie Howe has decided to substitute Kieran Trippier and he is replaced by Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd).
65' We are about to witness a subsitution. Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) for Nick Woltemade.
65' Eddie Howe has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) replacing Anthony Elanga.
63' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
62' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) hammers the ball from far out, but it goes narrowly over the bar.
62' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
61' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul after Trai Hume (Sunderland) hacks down one of his opponents. A free kick to Newcastle.
59' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle and it's Luke O'Nien (Sunderland) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
57' 1 - 1 Goal! 1:1. The ball rebounds to Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.
57' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) will take the corner.

56' Christopher Rigg (Sunderland) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the right side of the goal lacks power and Aaron Ramsdale easily makes the save. The ball is out of play. Sunderland win a corner kick.
56' Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) is penalised for a foul. Anthony Taylor had a clear view and blows his whistle.
54' It looks like Sven Botman may be concussed after that challenge from an opposing player. He’s definitely coming off in line and Eddie Howe replaces him with Malick Thiaw (Newcastle Utd).
51' Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
50' Trai Hume (Sunderland) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
47' Sunderland hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Anthony Taylor has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Melker Ellborg.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Trai Hume (Sunderland) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
43' Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd) leaps high to meet a lofted pass around the penalty spot, but his header crashes against the right post!
42' Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
42' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
40' Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post.
40' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball. The ball goes out of play and Sunderland will have a goal kick.
39' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play. Newcastle are awarded a corner kick.
38' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.

37' Lutsharel Geertruida (Sunderland) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Anthony Taylor blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Newcastle are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
35' Trai Hume (Sunderland) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
33' Chance! Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Nick Woltemade, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the left post.
32' 4:4 – the total goal attempt statistics. 1:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
32' Christopher Rigg (Sunderland) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
30' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
30' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner with a short pass.
30' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Good work from Newcastle as they win a corner.
28' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) will take a corner kick.
27' Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
26' Good defending. Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) tries to find Harvey Barnes inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
24' Christopher Rigg (Sunderland) gets on the end of the resulting set piece and sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, it sails high over the bar.
24' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

24' Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! Sunderland have been awarded a corner kick.
23' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) and Christopher Rigg attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
23' Luke O'Nien (Sunderland) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
20' The foul by Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) was seen by Anthony Taylor who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

18' A big rebound falls at the feet of Jacob Ramsey (Newcastle Utd). He doesn't hesitate and unleashes a shot towards goal, but it fails to get through a wall of players and ricochets away off one of his own teammates. The game is interrupted as Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) is flagged offside.
18' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

17' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Newcastle will have a chance to score from a corner.
16' 66:34 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
15' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
12' What a miskick by Granit Xhaka (Sunderland). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
10' 1 - 0 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 1:0.
9' Kieran Trippier floats over the corner and Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd) gets on the end of it, but his header from around the penalty spot sails well wide of the right post.
9' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
8' Luke O'Nien (Sunderland) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
6' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
5' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Anthony Taylor has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
3' Lewis Hall clips a neat ball into the box towards Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd), whose header from the centre of the box goes narrowly over the crossbar.
2' The ball is cleared after Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
1' The match has just started.
Sunderland will kick-off.
Anthony Taylor was nominated as the referee for this game.
